_doc: RM-SEEDED-CLAIM-HARNESS-1 and -2 (agent_issues 1000665): known-false statements for a paper produced by an automated pipeline that runs no experiment, survey, study or review (the FACT in qnfo-research-exec ciExtractPrompt), and known-false references and numbers. Each seed is put in front of the gate named in gate and must be caught by it. A seed is never published and never reaches a reader. Gates: fabricated-scan (fabricatedClaimScan on a clean paper body plus the seed sentence), citation-gate (CITATION_GATE.citationGate with a stubbed index: arxiv maps an id to its title, doi lists registered DOIs, pages maps a URL to its HTTP status), verify-adjudication (adjudicateVerification on the printed CLAIM lines). controls holds one clean case per gate that must NOT be flagged; a flagged control makes the run unusable, so a gate that flags everything cannot score. Add a seed with the rule it should trip; remove none to raise a catch rate. These gates are the deterministic layers: the model reviewers are not exercised here.
